# mistershell_command (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell command by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_command" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_command" "by_name" {
  name = "command"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Category.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `definition` (Dynamic) Definition.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `executor` (String) Executor.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) Is builtin.
- `is_editable_definition` (Boolean) Is editable definition.
- `mode` (String) Mode.
- `parameter_schema` (Dynamic) Parameter schema.
- `parse_source` (Dynamic) Parse source.
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
